svg.text: Implemented system (docker-compose) · green = write path · blue = read path · numbered steps explained below
Stores every report as history and keeps one latest-state row per station
Skips duplicate reports via a unique constraint on (station_id, reported_at)
All reads (API + dashboard) come from the stations latest-state table

g.text: POST /api/v1/reports: one report or a batch of up to 500.
Serializer validates the whole batch (all or nothing); the view calls the ingestion service.
Each report stored in health_reports; a duplicate (station_id + reported_at) is caught and counted, not stored.
Score computed from this report alone (pure function, config-driven).
Latest state updated only if this report is newer than the last; 201 {accepted, duplicates}.

svg.text: Read path — dashboard and API consumers

g.text: Browser loads /dashboard/ (HTML, JS, CSS from the app container).
Queries read only the stations latest-state table.
